title: MOTIF: Motivation-guided Topology Inference for Cold-start Multimodal Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.25381v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cold-start multimodal recommendation faces three coupled challenges: (i) sparse interactions obscure user intent, (ii) cold items remain topologically isolated, and (iii) similarity-based item graphs may cause semantic drift. To address these issues, we propose MOTIF, a Motivation-guided Topology Inference framework for cold-start multimodal recommendation. MOTIF integrates Semantic Motivation Reasoning, Knowledge-enhanced Graph Reconstruction, Weighted Graph Contrastive Learning, and Semantic-Structural Alignment. It uses offline LLM reasoning to infer motivation semantics, reconstructs transferable item-item topology, and learns robust graph embeddings without injecting generated text into prediction. Experiments on three multimodal benchmarks show consistent gains over graph-based, multimodal, cold-start, and LLM-enhanced baselines, with up to 6.07% relative improvement over the strongest recent baseline.

translated_title: MOTIF：基于动机引导的拓扑推断用于冷启动多模态推荐
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25381v1 公告类型：新 摘要：冷启动多模态推荐面临三个相互关联的挑战：（i）稀疏交互掩盖了用户意图，（ii）冷项目在拓扑上处于孤立状态，（iii）基于相似性的项目图可能导致语义漂移。为解决这些问题，我们提出了MOTIF，一种用于冷启动多模态推荐的动机引导拓扑推断框架。MOTIF整合了语义动机推理、知识增强图重构、加权图对比学习和语义-结构对齐。它利用离线大语言模型推理来推断动机语义，重构可迁移的项目-项目拓扑，并在不将生成文本注入预测的情况下学习稳健的图嵌入。在三个多模态基准上的实验显示，相比基于图、多模态、冷启动和LLM增强的基线，MOTIF持续取得改进，相较于最强近期基线有高达6.07%的相对提升。
tldr: MOTIF通过离线LLM推理动机语义和重构可迁移项目拓扑，在不注入生成文本的情况下，有效解决了冷启动多模态推荐中的稀疏交互、拓扑孤立和语义漂移问题，并在多个基准上取得显著性能提升。
en_tdlr: MOTIF addresses cold-start multimodal recommendation challenges by using offline LLM reasoning for motivation semantics and reconstructing transferable item topology, achieving consistent gains without injecting generated text into prediction.
